rows.grounds: First member of compound aṣṭapāda in the salutation formula 'aṣṭapādāya rudrāya namaḥ śarabhamūrttaye'.
Second member of compound aṣṭapāda, denoting the recipient in the salutation 'aṣṭapādāya rudrāya'.
Name of the deity addressed in the salutation 'aṣṭapādāya rudrāya namaḥ'.
Salutation term governing the addressed forms in 'namaḥ śarabhamūrttaye'.
First member of compound śarabhamūrti in 'namaḥ śarabhamūrttaye', naming the form.
Second member of compound śarabhamūrti, denoting the embodied form in the salutation 'namaḥ śarabhamūrttaye'.
